`--max-columns=abc` is parsed as a base-10 `usize`. `parseCount` calls `std.fmt.parseInt(usize, value, 10) catch null` (src/main.zig:813-814), so "abc" yields `null`.

In `parseArgs`, the `max-columns=` branch takes the text after the `=` and passes it to `parseCount`. On `null` it sets `opts.fail` with `.what = "bad value for --max-columns"` and `.arg` set to the offending value, then returns `error.Usage` (src/main.zig:1187-1191).

So the user gets a usage error naming "bad value for --max-columns" and echoing "abc". The option is not set.
